texts.facts: 1. Through the instant petition, the petitioner craves for indulgence of this Court for his being enlarged on regular bail, in case FIR No. 0373 dated 27.06.2023, under Section 346 of the IPC, (with Sections 201, 302 and 120-B IPC, added later on and Section 346 has been removed), registered at Police Station, Gharaunda, District Karnal. 2. The petitioner was arrested on 04.07.2023. The only allegation against the petitioner is that main accused before committing murder of the victim, handed over his mobile phone to the present petitioner, so that his mobile location could not connect the main accused with the crime.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that except the disclosure statement of main accused Sachin, there is nothing on record which could connect the present petitioner with the crime. He further submits that recovery of the mobile phone (though disputed) of the main accused, would also not complete the chain of circumstantial evidence so as to connect the present petitioner with the instant crime. He further submits that there is no allegation that he conspired with the main accused to commit murder nor any motive has been attributed to the present petitioner.
